metadata.coverage_note: Rows below the threshold and unparsed reports are not drawn on this over-threshold map. Rows above the threshold without reviewed coordinates are counted as unmapped. Follow-up context is inferred from later scraper-observed inspection rows for the same facility and the current-status fields on the facility page.
metadata.data_universe: Scraper-observed TPCHD Accela food-facility inspection records with parsed PDF reports; this public map layer includes only records over the red-point threshold.
metadata.freshness_note: Generated from the latest TPCHD scraper/publication run.
metadata.map_cannot_show: This map does not show neighborhood-level health risk, all inspections below the threshold, or rows without reviewed coordinates.
metadata.map_claim: Shows geocoded public restaurant inspection records with more than 35 red points, with current TPCHD rating and later observed inspection context where available.

privacy.review: Exact restaurant locations are public commercial facility addresses from public inspection records.

metadata.source_note: Tacoma-Pierce County Health Department Accela food-facility inspection pages and parsed inspection-report PDFs.

symbology.note: Evergreen markers use current TPCHD rating as the primary color/letter encoding. Alert/run maps use fixed red-point classes with darker red for higher totals. Marker size does not encode severity.

metadata.title: Tacoma-Pierce County restaurant inspection history and current ratings
